params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly renames local variables and method parameters from names with underscores (e.g., subject_1) to camelCase (e.g., subject1), which complies with the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the edits are minimal and focused solely on fixing the naming convention warning.
